title: Where does the evidence stop?
prompt: Label each statement about this experiment or proposed extension.
hint: A statement about all positive integers is not a statement about one tested start.

labels.text: Universal conjecture in the seed archive

items.text: An exact integer run from 6 reaches 1 after eight updates.
items.label: finite

items.text: A run from 27 is stopped after two updates without reaching 1.
items.label: inconclusive

items.text: Every positive integer eventually reaches 1 under T.
items.label: universal

feedback.pass: The failed-to-finish run is useful evidence about a budget, not a counterexample. The universal claim remains separate.
feedback.fail: Keep the quantifier “every” separate from a finite computation; preserve the run’s stopping reason.
